blocker.description: Live tool schemas and authenticated discovery require a browser OAuth approval against the operator's Magnific account; no repository content can complete this step
blocker.recovery: Run `npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.magnific.com` interactively (or via Code Mode tool discovery in a fresh session), complete the Magnific sign-in in the browser, then re-capture this fixture. To reset auth: delete the matching session under ~/.mcp-auth/ and reconnect.
